string-array.name: novidades
string-array.item: Podcasts: new “Suggestions” shelf with hand-picked shows in the TV’s language; OK follows. The first time, 4 are followed for you
Podcasts: “Search” and “Popular in your country” are on (Podcast Index)
Wallpaper plugins: the new “Plugin background” theme shows backgrounds from installed wallpaper plugins, with a credit line
Icons: each app can get its own icon from any installed icon pack (“Change icon” in the app menu); packs also work in banner mode
Icon packs stay frozen when not in use, so they use no memory
Settings › Plugins: a showcase of plugins with a QR code or Play Store button

string-array.name: roteiro_perguntas
string-array.item: Open Podcasts: is the “Suggestions” shelf there with covers, and does OK on one follow and open it?
In Podcasts › Find › Search podcasts, does typing “nerdcast” find NerdCast, and does “Popular in your country” show a list?
With a wallpaper plugin installed, does choosing the “Plugin background” theme show its background on the home screen?
Hold OK on an app › “Change icon”: does picking an icon from a pack change it on the home screen?
